```{=html}
<style>
/* Scoped under .flyer so it can't disturb the Quarto theme/navbar. */
.flyer, .flyer * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.flyer {
  --navy:#00205B; --gold:#b8912f; --ink:#1a1a1a; --gray:#444; --mut:#6b6b6b; --line:#e4e4e4;
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink);
  margin: 8px 0 24px;
}
.flyer .sheet { width: 100%; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 8px 8px; background: transparent; }
.flyer .eyebrow { text-align: center; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.flyer .display { text-align: center; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 48px; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.flyer .meta-inline { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 18px; }
.flyer .meta-inline span { font-size: 18px; color: #333; }
.flyer .meta-inline .dot { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
.flyer .subline { text-align: center; font-size: 18px; color: #555; margin-top: 6px; }
.flyer .subline b { color: var(--ink); }
.flyer .rule { height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; margin: 26px 0 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 62%, var(--gold) 62% 100%); }
.flyer .section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; margin: 20px 0 10px; }
.flyer .section-head .label, .flyer .section-head .dates { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
.flyer .item { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px 0; }
/* Each chip links to that session's PDF deck. */
.flyer .chip { flex: 0 0 140px; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; text-align: center; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; display: block; transition: background 0.15s; }
.flyer a.chip:hover, .flyer a.chip:focus { background: #003087; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }
.flyer a.chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }
.flyer .chip .chip-time { display: block; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; opacity: 0.85; margin-top: 2px; }
.flyer .item-title { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
.flyer .item-desc { font-size: 15.5px; color: var(--gray); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2px; }
.flyer .sheet-foot { margin-top: 28px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.flyer .sheet-foot a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--navy); font-weight: 700; }
.flyer .sheet-foot .url { font-size: 20px; }
.flyer .sheet-foot .zoom { font-size: 17px; }
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .flyer .display { font-size: 33px; }
  .flyer .chip { flex-basis: 108px; font-size: 12px; }
  .flyer .chip .chip-time { font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .flyer .item-title { font-size: 17px; }
}
</style>
<div class="flyer">
  <div class="sheet">
    <div class="eyebrow">Faculty Workshop &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; August 2026</div>
    <h1 class="display">Claude for Teaching &amp; Research</h1>
    <div class="meta-inline">
      <span>Eight 1-hour sessions</span><span class="dot">&bull;</span>
      <span>Zoom</span>
    </div>
    <div class="subline">led by <b>Kerry Back</b></div>

    <div class="section-head"><span class="label">Week 1</span><span class="dates">August 10&ndash;14</span></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/1_intro-to-claude.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 10<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Intro to Claude</div><div class="item-desc">Claude Desktop (Chat, Cowork, Code), Claude plugin for Excel</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/2_claude-tools.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 11<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Claude Tools</div><div class="item-desc">code execution, command line, web search and fetch, and browser use</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/3_skills-connectors-plugins.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 12<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Skills, Connectors, and Plugins</div><div class="item-desc">customizing Claude and adding capabilities</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/4_research-teaching-setup.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 13<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Research and Teaching Setup</div><div class="item-desc">Academic Studio, Python, R, LaTeX, Quarto, Git, GitHub</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/5_ai-for-teaching.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 14<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">AI for Teaching</div><div class="item-desc">NotebookLM, RAG chatbots, slide voice-overs</div></div></div>
    <div class="section-head"><span class="label">Week 2</span><span class="dates">August 17&ndash;19</span></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/6_student-projects.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 17<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Student Projects</div><div class="item-desc">artifacts, apps, agents</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/7_ai-for-research.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 19<span class="chip-time">3:00&ndash;4:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">AI for Research</div><div class="item-desc">literature search, knowledge databases, writing, and reviews</div></div></div>
    <div class="item"><a class="chip" href="pdf/8_agent-assistants.pdf" title="PDF slides">AUG 19<span class="chip-time">4:00&ndash;5:00 PM</span></a><div><div class="item-title">Agent Assistants</div><div class="item-desc">research team, personal assistants</div></div></div>
    <div class="sheet-foot">
      <a class="url" href="https://rice-workshop.kerryback.com">rice-workshop.kerryback.com</a>
      <a class="zoom" href="https://jgsb.zoom.us/j/95657980099?pwd=Ve5TMEaaBRQnhWnhnpaJFDHevFIbRU.1">Join on Zoom &rarr;</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
